insights:
The single best deal is MiMo-V2.5, which delivers the highest intelligence score of 49 out of 60 at a blended price of just $0.06 per million tokens, yielding a value score of 816.7—the best in the field. It offers a massive 1000K context window, a speed of 77 tokens per second, and strong arena Elo ratings of 1433 overall and 1435 on code tasks. No other model at this price point matches its intelligence, making it the clear leader for developers who need both reasoning capability and a large context window without paying a premium.

Two notable runners-up are DeepSeek V4 Flash and MiMo-V2-Flash. DeepSeek V4 Flash achieves an intelligence of 47 out of 60 at the same $0.06/M price, with a higher speed of 92 t/s and an identical 1000K context, but its value score of 783.3 trails MiMo-V2.5 due to slightly lower intelligence. MiMo-V2-Flash, also $0.06/M, scores only 41 in intelligence but compensates with 151 t/s speed and a 256K context, offering a faster alternative for latency-sensitive workloads where raw reasoning depth is less critical. Step 3.5 Flash at $0.06/M provides 223 t/s speed and moderate intelligence (38/60), best for high-throughput scenarios.

For the most common cost-sensitive API use case—where developers want maximum intelligence per dollar but can tolerate moderate latency—the actionable recommendation is to deploy MiMo-V2.5 as the default. Its combined intelligence, large context, and competitive speed at the same price point as slower models make it the optimal choice. If your application demands higher throughput and can accept lower reasoning quality, swap to MiMo-V2-Flash or Step 3.5 Flash for a 2–3x speed boost at the same cost.
